laptop.note: Built-in webcam. Change to "1" for a second camera.

phone.note: Android 'IP Webcam' app — use the IP the app shows; the trailing /video is required

gate.note: TP-Link Tapo — stream2 is the substream (lower resolution, faster for detection)

shop-hikvision.note: Hikvision — 101 is the main stream, 102 the substream

shop-dahua.note: Dahua / CP Plus — subtype=0 is main, subtype=1 is sub
